parameters.content:
## VWO QA Dashboard - read API

Webhook layer for the VWO QA Downtime Tracker dashboard.
All data comes from the sheets written by `09_DownTime_Tracker`.

| Endpoint | Sheet |
| --- | --- |
| GET /health-status | Health_Check_History |
| GET /health-checks | Health_Check_History |
| GET /logs | Health_Check_History |
| GET /response-times | Health_Check_History |
| GET /uptime | Daily_Availability |
| GET /incidents | Downtime_Incidents |
| GET /retry-history | Downtime_Incidents (derived) |
| POST /health-check | triggers the monitor workflow |
| GET /settings, POST /settings-write | Settings (Key/Value) |
| POST /incidents-resolve | Downtime_Incidents |

**Setup:**
1. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID` in every Google Sheets node (10) and
   `REPLACE_WITH_MONITOR_WORKFLOW_ID` in `API 08c`.
2. Attach your Google Sheets credential to those nodes.
3. **Activate** the workflow - webhooks only respond while it is active.

**Workbook tabs required**

- `Health_Check_History` (written by the monitor)
- `Downtime_Incidents` (written by the monitor)
- `Daily_Availability` (written by the monitor)
- `Settings` (optional - has Key/Value columns; when absent,
  `GET /settings` returns defaults because `API 09a` is set to continue on error)

Base URL of the webhooks: `https://<your-instance>/webhook/<path>`

**Note:** the monitor workflow emits `UP` / `DOWN` / `DEGRADED` / `FUNCTIONAL_FAILURE`;
the mappers normalise these to the dashboard's `HEALTHY` / `DOWN` / `SLOW` / `FUNCTIONAL_FAILURE`.
